page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 274 on the left. Marginal note in the left margin at the top (Christi typi / funerus). Main text in one column below. Ornamental rule, then centred headings and the text of the Breviarium in italic.

main_text.p: in corpore etiam in Cœlum assumptus, Gen. 5:24. Heb.11:5. Noe Christi typi funerus כהן consolator & Paracletus mundi, Gen.5:25. & sub eodem inprimis Diluvium & Arca Noæ, Esaj. 54:9. 1. Pet. 3:20.21. Melchisedecus, qui in sensu figurato & minuto Rex justitiæ, pacis, sine patre, sine matre, sine genealogia, non habens initium dierum, Sacerdos in perpetuum, Heb. 7:2.3. fuit: Isacus, quem Abrahamus mactare volens ἐν ἀλληγορίᾳ ἐνομίσθη in similitudine recepit, velut ex mortuo vivum, exemplar & typum resurgentium, Heb.11:19, Josephus a fratribus in foveam conjectus, venditus, in carcerem compactus, liberatus & factus totius Ægypti & familiæ paternæ omnis Sospitator. Quæ omnia quemadmodum in typis facta, Christo ceu Antitypo plenissimè congruant, res ipsa loquitur. LXXXVIII–XC.
main_text.head: LOCUS DECIMUS TERTIUS. DE OECONOMIA FOEDERIS GRATIÆ SUB LEGE MOSIS. BREVIARIUM.

p.i: Fœderis Gratiæ œconomia legalis. 1. Partes ejus contrahentes sunt Deus, ut Sanator populi; & populus Israel, exclusis gentibus. 2. Elenchus erroris contrarii. 3. Mediator fœderis verus Christus; typicus Moses fuit. 4. Vita Mosis privata & publica. 5. Stipulatio fœderis fuit mandatum Legis. 6. quæ nec mera lex fidei, nec mera lex operum, sed lex fidei, habens admixtum aliquid à Lege operum manans, & ad Christum ducens, fuit. 7. Legis illius duplex χέσις, Legalis & Evangelica fuit. 8. Legis in monte & tabernaculo latæ differentia. 9. Præceptorum Decalogo additorum differentia. 10. Legis onus ingravescens, & fer-

page.notes: Ornamental rule between the paragraphs and the headings. The Hebrew word in the margin note is printed as כהן in the scan; the Greek words are reproduced as far as legible. The reading of the Greek in the running text and the word "χέσις" are doubtful.
